verdict_definition: v3, registered 2026-11-18: v2's tests and thresholds on a development window fixed at 2010-01-01 to 2026-11-13, so a verdict no longer moves as data is added. Lead: the average trade beats the average of every possible trade of the same length (development p < 0.05 by resampling the rule's trades by calendar quarter, q < 0.10 across the run's strategy-and-entry tests; 1993-2009 p < 0.10), and CAGR is above buy-and-hold scaled to the same time in the market and volatility in a trade, in both periods. Trades signalled after 2026-11-13 are kept apart as the forward record; from 5 forward trades, a Lead whose forward mean excess falls below its development mean minus 2 standard errors is labelled 'Forward below band'. 1993-2009 also helped choose these signals, so it can remove a Lead but not confirm one.
